items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1994-01-15
items.q: Uh, Logan and somebody else. Anyway, there were five of them, I think, that owned the company.

ctx.x: Wasn't there a guy named Logan?

Uh, Logan and somebody else. Anyway, there were five of them, I think, that owned the company. And, uh, uh, I, I didn't profit from it and I don't think we, as, as CoVentures profited from it. It was a mistake. And there were other mistakes like that made. A lot of other mistakes like that made. Um. Didn't do a good job. You know, hindsight's 20-20. And I didn't do a good job. Really, really blew it. Blew it serious. I mean, I lost maybe $300,000 of my own money.
Now, when, when you started the company, I mean, you had the pressing plant, you had all these employees. Uh huh. You had, uh, studio. And I want to talk about Camp Street. Uh huh.
